name: Coffee Break
source: The main character of Coffee Break interacts with an interesting cast of characters in an office setting as the story progresses. The tale increases in craziness and sexual tension with each subsequent installment.
translation: 随着故事的进展，《咖啡时间》的主角在办公室环境中与一群有趣的角色互动。这个故事的疯狂和性紧张随着后续的每一部分而增加。
